acceptanceCriteria: The intended rule is recorded in the spec and covered by a test.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Found by the issue 354 lane; not reproduced as a retained regression. gate run refuses when the holder lease expired during an idle gap, even when the candidate and attempt are otherwise current. Expected: either a documented requirement to renew first with a clear refusal code and remedy, or gate evaluation that binds to the attempt and candidate without needing a live lease. Decide which is intended.
title: gate run requires an unexpired lease after an idle gap
